description: Default capability for the Beebeeb desktop windows. Targets the compact settings/app window, the first-launch onboarding window, the Windows main app window (`main-app`), and all on-demand conflict-resolution windows (label `conflict-<file_id>`, opened by the `open_conflict_window` IPC). Also covers the Windows onboarding webview (`windows-onboarding`) and the tray popup (`tray`) so that event listeners and IPC commands work on Windows webviews.
